evidence: Homepage shows "Showing 8 jobs" with a full list of 8 job cards (Senior Frontend Developer, Product Designer, Registered Nurse, Marketing Manager, Data Analyst, Part-Time Content Writer, DevOps Engineer, Elementary School Teacher).
Each job card displays title (e.g. "Senior Frontend Developer"), location (e.g. "San Francisco, CA"), and salary range (e.g. "$140k - $180k"), plus company, date, tags, industry and employment type.

Industry filter "Technology" narrowed 8→2 jobs; Location filter "Remote" narrowed to 2 remote jobs; Job Type filter "Contract" narrowed to 1 job (DevOps Engineer). Clear filters button resets to 8 jobs each time.
Typing "Nurse" into the search box instantly filtered results to "Showing 1 jobs" -> Registered Nurse.
Each filter/search change (Industry, Location, Job Type, keyword) updated the "Showing N jobs" count and list immediately without page reload.

Job details page for job-1 shows title, company, location, salary, posted date, full Job Description with Responsibilities and Requirements lists, and a Required Skills section (React, TypeScript, CSS, Node.js).

Job details page includes an "Apply for this position" form with Full Name, Email, Phone (contact info) and Cover Letter/Message fields; submitting valid data produced a toast "Application submitted! Your application for Senior Frontend Developer at TechCorp Solutions has been sent."
Submitting the application form with valid data completed without errors and displayed a success toast notification "Application submitted!".

Submitting the form empty triggered HTML5 required-field validation ("Please fill out this field.") for Name, Email, Message, blocking submission. Entering an invalid email "notanemail" triggered "Please include an '@' in the email address" validation, also blocking submission.

actual: Submitted an application for job-1 with name "Test User" and email "testuser@example.com", then submitted a second application to the same job with the identical name and email. Both submissions succeeded with an "Application submitted!" success toast and no warning/error about a duplicate application.

issue: Application submissions are not persisted to the backend
actual: Submitting the application form always shows a success toast ("Application submitted!"), but after submitting 3 additional applications to job-1 (including a uniquely-named "QA Tester" applicant), the Employer Dashboard's application count for that job and the Total Applications stat remained unchanged (2 and 3 respectively) even after a full page reload. The new applications never appear in the dashboard's applications list, indicating the system does not actually receive/store the submitted applications despite the success confirmation.

issue: No duplicate-application prevention, and applications are not persisted at all
actual: Submitted two applications to job-1 with identical name/email ("Test User" / "testuser@example.com"); both were accepted with a success toast and no duplicate warning. Additionally, neither submission (nor a third with different info) was reflected in the employer dashboard's application list/count even after reload, so duplicate submissions are not blocked by contact information.

evidence: Employer Dashboard "Your Job Listings" section lists all 5 posted jobs (Senior Frontend Developer, Product Designer, Marketing Manager, Part-Time Content Writer, DevOps Engineer) each with industry, type, location, salary, and post date.

Clicking the applications-count button (e.g. "2") on the Senior Frontend Developer listing expanded an "Applications (2)" panel listing applicant details (Alex Johnson, Maria Garcia) with contact info and message, for that specific job posting.

The expanded Applications panel for Senior Frontend Developer clearly lists two distinct applicants (Alex Johnson - alex.j@email.com/555-0101/Jan 20, Maria Garcia - maria.g@email.com/555-0102/Jan 22) each with their own name, contact info, date, and cover-letter message.

Filled out Post a New Job form (Title: QA Automation Engineer, Industry: Technology, Type: Full-time, Location: Chicago IL, Salary 90000-130000, Description, Skill: Selenium) and clicked Post Job. Success toast "Job posted successfully!" appeared, Active Jobs count increased 5→6, and the new listing "QA Automation Engineer · Chicago, IL · $90k - $130k" appeared on the Employer Dashboard.

Clicking "Post Job" with all fields empty did not create a listing; browser-native required-field validation blocked submission with "Please fill out this field." messages on Job Title, Min/Max Salary, and Job Description fields (all required), and dropdowns are required selects.

issue: No authentication/authorization separating job seekers from employers
actual: There is no login, signup, or role-based access control anywhere in the app. The "Post a Job" link and /employer/post-job page are freely accessible to any visitor without any employer authentication, and the form was successfully submitted (job "QA Automation Engineer" was published) with no identity check. Any job seeker visiting the site can post a job opening in the exact same way an employer would.

issue: No edit functionality for published job listings
actual: Delete works: clicking the trash icon on a job listing opens a "Delete this job?" confirmation dialog, and confirming removes the job from the dashboard (verified by deleting the test-created "QA Automation Engineer" listing, which disappeared from "Your Job Listings"). However, no "Edit" button, link, or affordance exists anywhere on the Employer Dashboard or job listing cards to modify an already-published job's details (title, description, salary, etc.) - only a delete (trash) icon and an applications-count toggle are present.
